title: Identifying Harm in Personalized, Generative AI Systems Requires User-Centered Auditing at the Interaction Level
abstract: arXiv:2608.14692v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Personalized, generative AI systems increasingly adapt their behavior to individual users over time, fundamentally changing model behavior. While existing auditing approaches have been effective at surfacing harms in non-personalized contexts, they often rely on static, simulated evaluations and definitions of harm that aggregate across broad, group categories. In this position paper, we argue that such approaches can fail to capture emergent harms in personalized generative AI systems, where harms surface through interpretations of ongoing interaction and evolve with user history. We identify three presuppositions underlying many harm auditing paradigms: that harms can be (1) specified outside real-world interaction, (2) defined non-pluralistically within groups, and (3) treated as static. One might argue that personalized systems could simply learn definitions of what constitutes harm to individual users through repeated interactions

translated_title: 识别个性化生成式AI系统中的危害需在交互层面进行以用户为中心的审计
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14692v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：个性化生成式AI系统随时间推移日益适应个体用户的行为，从根本上改变了模型行为。尽管现有审计方法在非个性化情境中有效揭示了危害，但它们往往依赖于静态、模拟的评估以及跨广泛群体类别聚合的危害定义。在本立场论文中，我们认为这类方法可能无法捕捉个性化生成式AI系统中涌现的危害，因为这些危害通过持续交互的解释显现，并随用户历史演变。我们识别出许多危害审计范式背后的三个预设：危害可（1）在真实世界交互之外被指定，（2）在群体内以非多元方式定义，以及（3）被视为静态。有人可能争辩说，个性化系统可以通过重复交互简单地学习个体用户构成危害的定义。
tldr: 本文指出个性化生成式AI系统的危害审计需转向以用户为中心的交互层面，挑战现有静态、群体聚合的审计预设，强调危害是动态涌现的。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that harm auditing for personalized generative AI systems must shift to user-centered interaction-level approaches, challenging static, group-aggregated paradigms and emphasizing harms as dynamically emergent.
